conservative.read: This conservative plan targets modest returns, aiming for approximately 1.5% per month. It prioritizes capital preservation and significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and maintaining a substantial cash buffer. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting around 2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced approach to growth and risk management.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to cure concentration and meet the mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for approximately 4% per month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-performing assets and top scanner setups. Be aware this approach carries substantially higher drawdown risk and daily decay from leveraged ETFs, and can lead to rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

income.read: This income plan aims for steady monthly distributions, targeting approximately 1% per month. It rotates heavily into income and covered-call ETFs while cutting leveraged and high-beta single names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
